svg.aria-label: Astronaut sitting on an asteroid next to a satellite. No data yet.
svg.text: We’re preparing the animation for you…
Please wait while the universe finds its charger.
Our hamsters are running the servers as fast as they can.
Asking the stars nicely. They said “maybe”.
Counting to infinity. We’re at 7, almost there.
Waiting for the universe to stop buffering.
